bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
target="$repo/.worktrees/link-pr55-20261115"
cd "$repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || { echo LIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED; exit 74; }
test "$(realpath "$repo")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test ! -e "$target" || { echo EXISTING_LINK_WORKTREE; git -C "$target" rev-parse HEAD; exit 73; }
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/link-two-line-telegram-20261114
head="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
test "$head" = eca68464881ec4b26dc399f6c7323153232e2696 || { echo PR_HEAD_CHANGED; exit 74; }
mkdir -p "$repo/.worktrees"
git worktree add --detach "$target" "$head"
test "$(realpath "$target")" = "$target"
test "$(git -C "$target" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"
echo "LINK_WORKTREE_CREATED=PASS"
echo "WORKTREE=$target"
echo "HEAD=$head"
echo "LIVE_HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "LIVE_COMPOSE_DIRTY=$(test -n "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain -- deploy/gserver-compose.yaml)" && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "PR_FILES_PRESENT=$(test -f "$target/artifacts/bot/src/services/linkInlineShare.ts" && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "SOURCE_READY=PASS"
